name: JoAi: Update Automation

description.en: Update name, enabled flag, trigger, or agent of a lifecycle automation. To replace actions use set_automation_actions. To remove permanently with no active enrollments use delete_automation; otherwise set enabled to 0.
description.de: Aktualisiert Name, enabled, Trigger oder Agent einer Automation. Aktionen ersetzen über set_automation_actions. Permanent löschen (ohne aktive Enrollments): delete_automation — sonst enabled auf 0.
description.fr: Met à jour le nom, enabled, le déclencheur ou l'agent. Pour remplacer les actions, utilisez set_automation_actions. Suppression définitive sans enrollments actifs : delete_automation — sinon mettez enabled à 0.
description.es: Actualiza nombre, enabled, trigger o agente. Para sustituir acciones usa set_automation_actions. Borrado permanente sin enrollments activos: delete_automation — si no, pon enabled en 0.
description.it: Aggiorna nome, enabled, trigger o agente. Per sostituire le azioni usa set_automation_actions. Eliminazione permanente senza enrollment attivi: delete_automation — altrimenti imposta enabled a 0.
description.ro: Actualizează numele, enabled, triggerul sau agentul. Pentru acțiuni folosește set_automation_actions. Ștergere permanentă fără enrollment-uri active: delete_automation — altfel setează enabled pe 0.

bot: Pass automationId hashid. To replace actions use set_automation_actions. To disable: enabled=0. To permanently remove with no active enrollments: delete_automation. enabled: pass 1 or 0.

inputs.name: Automation ID
inputs.bot: Opaque public hashid from the list or get API. Never use a numeric internal database id — only the public hashid (or slug where documented).

description.en: Public hashid (not an internal database id)

inputs.name: Enabled
inputs.bot: Pass 1 or 0 (or true/false). Use 0 to disable; use delete_automation to remove when idle.

inputs.name: Trigger config
inputs.bot: For prop: {"propKey":"…","propValue":"…"}. For segment: {"segmentId":"…"}. For webhook: {"source":"…"}.

inputs.name: Agent ID
inputs.bot: Optional agent UUID (required for webhook triggers / message warps). Pass empty string to clear.

error.fr: Échec de la mise à jour de l'automatisation : {{MESSAGE}}
error.es: No se pudo actualizar la automatización: {{MESSAGE}}
